title: Maple Creek 2017 earthquake-catalog construction (minimal instructions, expert tools, catalog checker and knowledge) - development window
summary: As the checker arm, plus the catalog-knowledge skill (pilot protocol, deciding between candidates, symptom playbook, errors no check sees) and the magnitude resource. Isolates the value of procedural knowledge over the whole pipeline (S3). Development loop: one day around the mainshock (2017-06-15T22:48:00Z to 2017-06-16T22:48:00Z).
